subject: Dual pilot contracting: Salesloft + Outreach (security & license asks)
messages:
From: Elena Morales <elena.morales@revops-procure.com>
To: connor_obrien@redwood.ai
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, ben_carter@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 10 Jun 2029 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Pilot contracting for Sales engagement tools

Connor —

Thanks for the call this morning. As discussed, DemoCloud is looking to run a 6–8 week side-by-side pilot of Salesloft and Outreach for a ~120-rep seat group ahead of their FY30 procurement decision. Procurement needs a short SOW and a security/controls sheet before legal will issue the PO.

Can you send: 
- A one-page SOW for the pilot (deliverables, timeline, success metrics).
- Security questionnaire responses (SOC2 scope, data residency, SSO/SCIM support).
- High-level pricing for a 3-month pilot and a 12-month expansion option (per-rep list + discounts).

They also requested a single point of contact for contract redlines. 

Appreciate a send by EOD Thursday so our legal team can start review.

Thanks,
Elena Morales
Senior Procurement Manager
DemoCloud Inc.

From: connor_obrien@redwood.ai
To: Elena Morales <elena.morales@revops-procure.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, ben_carter@redwood.ai, laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 10 Jun 2029 11:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pilot contracting for Sales engagement tools

Elena —

Thanks, sending a consolidated package shortly. Quick clarifications so the SOW aligns with your expectations: 
1) Pilot scope — do you want both vendors running against the same accounts and cadences, or split cohorts by geography?
2) Is DemoCloud insisting on vendor-hosted data residency in US only, or will multi-region (US primary, EU backup) be acceptable?
3) Success metrics — beyond conversion uplift, should we include token-level API usage caps for reporting?

Action plan from our side: I’ll draft the SOW and license comparison (attached) and loop vendor security contacts for the questionnaire responses. Marissa will own pricing scenarios; Ben will lead the SSO/SCIM and integration checklist with your engineering contact.

Target: SOW + Security Q by Thu EOD. Connor

Connor O'Brien
Senior Solutions Manager | Redwood Inference
connor_obrien@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0192

From: Alyssa Chen <alyssa.chen@salesloft.com>
To: connor_obrien@redwood.ai
Cc: tom.rivera@outreach.io, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 11 Jun 2029 08:40:00 -07:00
Subject: Salesloft — pilot SOW and security packet

Connor / team —

Following our product sync, attaching our compact SOW template and Salesloft security packet. Notes: 
- We can support SAML SSO + SCIM provisioning (enterprise plan).
- SOC 2 Type II report available under NDA (we can do controlled sharing to DemoCloud legal).
- Pilot pricing: $10k flat for 3 months for up to 125 seats (includes onboarding + success manager). Expansion list price would be $64/seat/mo with tiered discounts starting 10% at 500 seats.

I’ve marked the SAML and PII-handling sections — Happy to join a legal call if needed.

Regards,
Alyssa Chen
Enterprise Sales Engineer, Salesloft
Attachment: Salesloft_Pilot_SOW.pdf

From: Tom Rivera <tom.rivera@outreach.io>
To: connor_obrien@redwood.ai
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, ben_carter@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 12 Jun 2029 10:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Outreach pilot materials + license flexibility

Connor —

Attaching Outreach pilot SOW and our security questionnaire answers. Two flags from our security team: (1) data export controls for audit logs must be enabled for external auditors; (2) if you require EU-only residency for any test accounts, that will change the setup lead time from 3 days to ~2 weeks.

License note: We can do a lowered pilot fee ($6k for 3 months) if DemoCloud signs a 12-month expansion committed at start of pilot (we can add a 90-day opt-out).

Basic attachments: Outreach_Pilot_SOW.pdf; Outreach_Sec_Q_A.pdf

Best,
Tom Rivera
Partner Success — Outreach

From: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
To: Elena Morales <elena.morales@revops-procure.com>, connor_obrien@redwood.ai
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.ai, laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 13 Jun 2029 09:30:00 -07:00
Subject: Draft SOW + license comparison (attached)

Elena —

Attached is a consolidated package: 1-page pilot SOW, a license-comparison matrix (Salesloft vs Outreach), and our vendor security questionnaire we populated. High-level summary: 
- Pilot length: 8 weeks running side-by-side on 2 matched cohorts (by ARR band).
- Deliverables: onboarding, 2 enablement sessions, data export for audit, weekly health syncs, final impact report with KPI dashboard.
- Pricing: Salesloft pilot $10k / Outreach pilot $6k with conditional expansion discounts in both vendor offers (see matrix).
- Integration notes: both vendors support SSO/SCIM; near-term gap is automated activity sync to HubSpot (we recommend a short middleware job to normalize events; estimate 2–3 days dev).

Attachments: SalesTools_Pilot_SOW.pdf; License_Comparison_Table.xlsx; Security_Questionnaire_Connex.docx

Next steps: please confirm you want matched cohorts (recommended) and whether DemoCloud requires EU-only test accounts. If you sign off, we’ll send SOWs to legal and prep a simple PO path (Net 30).

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Solutions Lead | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai

From: Elena Morales <elena.morales@revops-procure.com>
To: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, connor_obrien@redwood.ai
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.ai, laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 21 Jun 2029 16:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Draft SOW + license comparison (attached)

Marissa / Connor —

Appreciate the thorough packet. Confirm DemoCloud will proceed with matched cohorts for the 8-week pilot. Two legal asks before we route to PO: 
1) Please provide a short paragraph describing how Redwood handles access to raw activity data during the pilot (who can download CSVs, retention by default).
2) Confirm that vendors will provide SOC2 Type II reports under NDA and that audit log exports can be produced within 48 hours on request.

Also, can you send a single-point-contract contact for redlines? Our legal prefers to loop a single vendor contact rather than multiple negotiation threads.

If we get those answers by Monday EOD (24 Jun), procurement will aim to issue the PO by Friday (28 Jun).

Regards,
Elena Morales
Senior Procurement Manager
DemoCloud Inc.

P.S. CCing our internal security lead at procurement@democloud.com for visibility.
